import models

    parsed = parsing.parse(input())
    if parsed is None:
        continue
    name, amount = parsed
    depot.add(name, amount)
    accepted += 1
query = input()
distance = int(input())
storage.save('stations.json', depot.records)
report = {'accepted': accepted, 'query': depot.get(query), 'total': depot.total()}
